item.title: Araghchi to Barrot: Before lecturing Iran, ensure Iranians’ freedom of expression in France
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has criticized France’s top diplomat over his post on X concerning the rights and freedom of expression of Iranians, saying Jean-Noël Barrot’s words expose his double standards.

item.title: President Pezeshkian says Iran will not bow to US, Israeli bullying
